dispositions.shipped: the opted-in GET stream resumes from the last observed event id with the server retry value (ports/W05-get-resume.md), a replacement refreshes the private catalog before adoption, and list_changed refetches immediately and marks the server dirty (ports/W05-list-changed-refetch.md); a resource whose update was lost is reported stale-known, never current
